title: Count the vowels
promptMd: Read one line of text and print how many vowels (`a e i o u`, upper or lower case) it contains.
starterCode: # Read input with input(), print output with print().
hints: Read the whole line, including spaces.
Look at one character at a time.
Upper-case vowels count too — convert each character to lower case before checking, or check both.
conceptNoteMd:
Strings are sequences of characters.

```python
s = input()
for ch in s:
    if ch.isdigit():
        print("digit", ch)
print(s.upper())
```
